body:
Hi @RyanTheAllmighty, thank you for reporting this 👍  I assume you were able to implement the behavior of your choice using our `connectMultiRange`connector? If you have a little gif to share it would be nice of you :)

As for should we implement this behaviour on our default `<MultiRange/>`, I agree it could be nice to be able to remove a selected range without being force to use <CurrentRefinements/>. Today you are able to do it by adding another item that will be the largest range. But maybe that's something we can compute on our side.

WDYT @vvo and @bobylito?
